promise: By the end, an empty screen has become a living land, and you see where a city for 1.3 million people will stand.

sections.title: One tent, one question
sections.setting: Black, then a single tent on an empty meadow
sections.feeling: A held breath: can this be true?
sections.question: Can a city for 1.3 million people start from one tent and an empty screen?
sections.release: None: the question is left open
sections.gate: Stillness to speed: one held image and silence break into a montage that quickens with its music

sections.title: The trailer
sections.setting: One drone take over the real city to Samuel with his arms wide, then the game's map turning into the city
sections.music: Its own theme: cinematic, hopeful, friendly; D major, about 105 bpm; one big chord at the end
sections.question: One million humans, a hundred times better way of living: how?
sections.release: First in a game, then for real: the big chord, the lights come on
sections.gate: Flight to standing still, promise to person: the montage ends on its big chord and one voice begins, slowly, over the empty land

sections.title: The vision
sections.setting: Samuel alone above the empty land, the city's 898 plots laid over it
sections.question: Why would anyone build a city from nothing, and for whom?
sections.release: One village is named and opened: Vision Village, round one tent

beats.note: The doubt: it is only one person and one tent
The first village gets its name

sections.gate: Sky to ground, plan to mud, voice to hands: from one quiet voice high above down to the water's edge, from speaking to trying

sections.title: A river that is a ditch
sections.setting: At the water's edge, feet on the sand
sections.question: Why does the river look like a ditch?
sections.release: It bends, cuts a bank, lays a gravel bar: it reads as a river

beats.note: Banks with hard lines: still wrong
The first bend that looks real

sections.gate: Play to pressure: easy tinkering by the water turns into a fight with one stubborn tree, flowing shots to hard cuts

sections.title: The tree that failed
sections.setting: One pine, alone, against photos of the real one
sections.question: Can a tree made of numbers ever look like the photo?
sections.release: The umbrella crown stands; then a whole forest of every age

beats.note: A short trunk and a flat plate
Every tree alike; the leaves flicker

sections.gate: Fight to flight, tight to wide: hard cuts on one stubborn tree open into one unbroken rise; the staccato stops, the theme begins

sections.title: The rise
sections.setting: One unbroken move from the forest floor up through the clouds to three kilometres
sections.music: The hook's low note returns as a full theme
sections.question: So: did an empty screen become a world?
sections.release: Yes. And from up here the plots appear: this is where the city goes

beats.note: Up through the crowns, over the river and the forest
The plots come in over the land

sections.gate: Triumph to unease, gold to slate: from the widest view of the film down to one tent, and the light goes; the theme breaks off

sections.title: The first gust
sections.setting: The tent at dusk; the canvas begins to move, clouds close over the last light
sections.music: The theme breaks off; wind, one low drone
sections.question: A storm is coming. Does one tent hold?
sections.release: None: cut to black on the first gust. Tomorrow.

beats.note: One citizen, one tent, all quiet
